 Numerology Lucky Number & Colour, 11th November: Mirror Date 11-11 Carries Mercury’s Number 5—Messages From Siblings and Old Friends Matter Today 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Numerology Lucky Number & Colour, 11th November: Mirror Date 11-11 Carries Mercury’s Number 5—Messages From Siblings and Old Friends Matter Today 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 11, 2026, 07:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Wednesday, 11 November 2026, carries Mercury twice over. The date adds up to 5, Mercury’s number, and Wednesday itself is Mercury’s weekday. On top of that, the mirror pattern of 11-11 turns attention back to the people who have always been around, like the brother who rarely calls first or the school friend you meant to message after the festivals. Mercury rules Gemini, the third sign of the zodiac, which is tied to siblings and everyday communication. Right now Mercury is retrograde in Scorpio and only days away from turning direct, which is why familiar names keep resurfacing. Answer them. Just hold back on joint plans involving money or travel until the end of the week. Watch Aries ,Taurus & Gemini : What This Phase May Be Trying to Warn You About | Ft. Shruti Kharbanda Lucky Number, Colour, Direction and Best Time for November 11, 2026
 Birth Number 1: Born on 1, 10, 19 or 28
 A brother or sister may be quietly waiting for you to make the first call. Sun-ruled people are often too busy to notice that others need reaching out to. Pick up the phone this evening. Even a short chat can undo weeks of silence. Lucky Number: 2 Lucky Colour: Sky Saffron Lucky Direction: East Best Time: 9:05 AM to 10:35 AM Birth Number 2: Born on 2, 11, 20 or 29
 An old friend might send a message that brings back a particular memory, good or uncomfortable. Take your time over the reply. The Moon’s people feel these things deeply, so answer when you’re calm and suggest meeting next week instead of today. Lucky Number: 7 Lucky Colour: Pearl Grey Lucky Direction: North West Best Time: 1:40 PM to 3:10 PM Birth Number 3: Born on 3, 12, 21 or 30
 Jupiter’s number does well in group conversations, and a family chat may come alive with plans for a reunion. Enjoy it, but keep personal finances out of the discussion. Bookings can wait until Mercury is moving forward again. Lucky Number: 1 Lucky Colour: Lemon Lilac Lucky Direction: North East Best Time: 10:20 AM to 11:50 AM Birth Number 4: Born on 4, 13, 22 or 31
 An old disagreement with a sibling could resurface through a casual comment. Stick to what actually happened, without dragging in years of history. Rahu-ruled people often come out of these talks well by staying calm while others get emotional. Lucky Number: 9 Lucky Colour: Sand Olive Lucky Direction: South West Best Time: 3:55 PM to 5:25 PM Birth Number 5: Born on 5, 14 or 23
 This is your number on Mercury’s own weekday, so expect a busy phone. Not every message deserves an instant reply. Look for the one from a former colleague or classmate, because it may carry a lead worth following after the weekend. Lucky Number: 5 Lucky Colour: Fern Silver Lucky Direction: North Best Time: 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM Birth Number 6: Born on 6, 15 or 24
 A younger cousin or sibling may come to you with a personal problem. Listen fully and avoid lecturing. Venus-ruled people are trusted for their warmth, and what’s needed today is support more than a ready-made answer. Lucky Number: 3 Lucky Colour: Rose Mist Lucky Direction: South East Best Time: 6:20 PM to 7:50 PM Birth Number 7: Born on 7, 16 or 25
 Someone you lost touch with long ago could reach out without warning. Ketu’s people often sense the reason before they’re told. Reply when you’re ready, and decide slowly how much of your life to share again. Lucky Number: 8 Lucky Colour: Ink Lavender Lucky Direction: West Best Time: 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM Birth Number 8: Born on 8, 17 or 26
 A sibling might raise a matter involving family property or shared savings. Hear them out but keep commitments for later. Ask for the papers and go through them carefully. Saturn favours family money matters settled with records over those settled with promises. Lucky Number: 4 Lucky Colour: Bronze Slate Lucky Direction: South Best Time: 2:45 PM to 4:15 PM Birth Number 9: Born on 9, 18 or 27
 A friend from your past may ask for a favour. Mars gives you a strong urge to help, which is admirable. Offer what is realistic and say so clearly. Keeping your own week on track matters just as much. Lucky Number: 6 Lucky Colour: Brick Lilac Lucky Direction: North-Northeast Best Time: 8:15 AM to 9:45 AM
